title: 第2475章 天剑诀第2474章 雷蟒吞天
slug: 重生本统子教宿主当老六
content_zh:
眼见己方死伤惨重，宋焱不由得怒火中烧，眼底的怒火几乎都要从眼睛里喷出来了。
但他也知道自己现在不能乱了阵脚，如果连他都失了方寸，那这场大战可就彻底没救了。
在犹豫了一瞬后，他的眼中顿时闪过一抹狠厉之色：“既然如此，那就以其人之道还治其人之身好了。”
下一秒，他猛地凝聚起了大量元力，朝着迟辛虎打出一道百丈长的金色大手，竟然引得数千米之下的地面都随之震动了起来。
见状，迟辛虎连忙凝聚起大量的元力汇聚到手中的长剑上，然后猛地向前斩出了一道百丈长的白色剑气。
两人的攻击猛烈地碰撞在一起，当场就引发了一场剧烈的爆炸，爆炸的威力甚至让周围的空间都出现了波动。
虽说剑修在同境界中大多属于攻伐之力很强的那一批存在，但双方可是有着一个小境界的差距。
而且，八境巅峰的上限是不固定的，两人实际上的修为差距远不是简单的一个小境界能够形容的。
在这股爆炸产生的元力波动面前，迟辛虎虽然极力抵挡，但还是被震出了内伤，嘴角当场就溢出了一丝血迹。
攻伐之力强大但体魄偏弱，这是大部分剑修的通病，即便迟辛虎的体魄不算弱，但和同境界的其他人相比也不算突出。
趁着迟辛虎受伤的机会，宋焱再度朝着他打出一道百米长的金色掌印，虽然不如刚才那一掌的威力大，但也着实不容小觑。
迟辛虎强压着胸闷的感觉，连忙挥剑进行抵挡，但还是当场被这道掌印打飞了出去，直接被埋进了两座大山之中。
虽然这一掌加重了迟辛虎的伤势，但对于一名八境九重大修士来说还不足以致命。
他原以为宋焱会趁机追杀他，但当他从滚滚烟尘中冲出来时，却发现宋焱没有追杀他的打算，而是朝着他带来的那些飞舟冲了过去。
那些飞舟上现在只有一些七境五重的修士，像宋焱这种八境巅峰大修士冲过去就像虎入羊群一般，那些人根本抵挡不住他的攻势。
迟辛虎心中暗道不妙，连忙释放元力和剑意，在周身凝聚出了数万把银白色的元力飞剑朝着宋焱扫射而去。
他知道自己本就不是宋焱的对手，如今又有伤在身，根本就追不上宋焱，也无法凭一己之力拦住对方。
但如果自己的这些飞剑能够稍稍减缓对方飞行的速度，那些飞舟上的弟子就可以将炮台瞄准宋焱。
虽说哪怕是那些巨型飞舟的元力炮台也伤不到宋焱，但他们这边可是有数百艘飞舟。
若是这些飞舟的炮台能够同时命中宋焱，那威力也绝对够这位八境巅峰大修士喝一壶的了。

虽然迟辛虎预想的很好，不出意外的话接下来的情况也确实会这样发生，但现实却和他预想的截然不同。
只见宋焱取出并激活了一件巴掌大小的金色圆盘，他的身上顿时泛起了一层金色光膜。
迟辛虎的那些元力飞剑打在他身上只发出了一阵金铁碰撞的声音，完全没对他造成任何伤害。
而那些飞舟刚刚将元力炮台对准了宋焱，宋焱就已经冲到了离他最近的一艘飞舟面前，随手就把那艘飞舟给撞碎了。
content_en:
Seeing the heavy casualties on his side, Song Yan couldn't help but feel furious, and the anger in his eyes almost spurted out.
But he also knew that he couldn't mess up his position now. If he even lost his position, the battle would be completely hopeless.
After hesitating for a moment, a stern look suddenly flashed in his eyes: "In that case, let's treat him in his own way."
The next second, he suddenly gathered a lot of energy and shot a golden hand that was a hundred feet long towards Chi Xinhu, causing the ground thousands of meters below to shake.
Seeing this, Chi Xinhu quickly gathered a large amount of Yuan energy on the long sword in his hand, and then suddenly slashed forward with a white sword energy that was a hundred feet long.
The two attacks collided violently, triggering a violent explosion on the spot. The power of the explosion even caused the surrounding space to fluctuate.
Although most sword cultivators in the same realm belong to a group of beings with strong offensive power, there is a small realm gap between the two sides.
Moreover, the upper limit of the peak of the Eighth Realm is not fixed, and the actual cultivation gap between the two is far beyond what can be described by a simple small realm.
Although Chi Xinhu tried his best to resist the energy fluctuation caused by the explosion, he was still injured internally, and a trace of blood spilled from the corner of his mouth on the spot.
Strong offensive power but weak physique is a common problem among most swordsmen. Even though Chi Xinhu's physique is not weak, it is not outstanding compared to other people in the same realm.
Taking advantage of Chi Xinhu's injury, Song Yan once again hit him with a hundred-meter-long golden palm print. Although it was not as powerful as the previous palm, it should not be underestimated.
Chi Xinhu suppressed the feeling of tightness in his chest and quickly swung his sword to resist, but he was still knocked away by the palm print on the spot and was directly buried in two mountains.
Although this palm aggravated Chi Xinhu's injuries, it was not fatal to an eighth-level and ninth-level monk.
He originally thought that Song Yan would take the opportunity to chase him, but when he rushed out of the billowing smoke, he found that Song Yan had no intention of chasing him, but rushed towards the flying boats he brought.
There are only some seventh-level and fifth-level monks on those flying boats. A top-level eighth-level monk like Song Yan rushes over like a tiger rushing into a herd of sheep. Those people can't resist his offensive at all.
Chi Xinhu secretly thought something was wrong, and quickly released his Yuan Power and sword intent, condensing tens of thousands of silver-white Yuan Power flying swords around him and shooting towards Song Yan.
He knew that he was no match for Song Yan, and now that he was injured, he could not catch up with Song Yan, nor could he stop him by himself.
But if these flying swords of his can slightly slow down the opponent's flying speed, the disciples on the flying boat can aim the turret at Song Yan.
Although even the Yuanli forts of those giant flying boats could not hurt Song Yan, there were hundreds of flying boats on their side.
If the turrets of these flying boats could hit Song Yan at the same time, their power would definitely be enough to make this eighth-level peak monk drink a pot.
Although Chi Xinhu had a good expectation, and if nothing unexpected happened, the next situation would indeed happen like this, but the reality was completely different from what he expected.
Song Yan took out and activated a palm-sized golden disk, and a golden light film suddenly appeared on his body.
Chi Xinhu's flying swords of Yuanli only made a sound of gold and iron colliding when they hit him, and did not cause any harm to him at all.
As soon as those flying boats aimed their Yuanli turrets at Song Yan, Song Yan had already rushed to the nearest flying boat and smashed it into pieces.
